description: Wraps GET /start/s/{token}. An unclaimed site's results. What the results link answers: while the site is unclaimed, its status, where its checks stand and its status data; once someone claims it, only that it was claimed and when (their team reads it with its own key). Needs no key.

token.description: The results link's token (sr_…): the end of the `results` link POST /start answered. Private: never post it or send it to another site

name: start_results

alerts.description: Who is alerted, in words: no one until it's claimed

alerts_enabled.description: Always false until a person claims the site: no one is alerted

claimed.description: False while no one has claimed it

data.description: The site's status data: the same shape as a public status page's data.json

interval_seconds.description: How often the homepage is checked, in seconds: every 30 minutes at first, once a day after 30 days unclaimed

last_checked_at.description: The newest check, or null before the first (ISO 8601, UTC); null when there's none

next_check_at.description: When the next check is due (the newest plus the interval), or null before the first (ISO 8601, UTC); null when there's none

watching_since.description: When it was first started (ISO 8601, UTC)

claimed.description: Someone claimed the site: their team reads it now, with its own key

next_steps.description: The calls that usually come next

title: An unclaimed site's results
